1.consolidated_definition: De alto copete. “Con tal que fuera buena gente, que fuera sólo de mayoría.” Zeno Gandía, El negocio, 1922, cap. XIII.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Of high standing. "As long as they were good people, as long as it was a majority." Zeno Gandía, The Business, 1922, chap. XIII.
